title: Sorting the Sentence
description:
You are given a shuffled sentence s.

Each word has a number at the end (1 to 9)
The number tells the original position of the word
Task
Rearrange the words based on their numbers
Remove the numbers
Return the original sentence
Example

Example 1

"is2 sentence4 This1 a3"
→ "This is a sentence"

Example 2

"Myself2 Me1 I4 and3"
→ "Me Myself and I"
Rules
Words are separated by one space
Each word ends with a digit (1–9)
No leading/trailing spaces
Max 9 words
input_format: The input contains a single string.
constraints:
2 <= s.length <= 200
s consists of lowercase and uppercase English letters, spaces, and digits from 1 to 9.
The number of words in s is between 1 and 9.
The words in s are separated by a single space.
s contains no leading or trailing spaces.
